root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the punctuation-run loop at `while(clause_type_from_codepoint(c2) & (CLAUSE_QUESTION | CLAUSE_EXCLAMATION))` may issue `GetC()`, `Eof()` must be false.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the punctuation-run loop with `c2` still holding `'.'` and `Eof()` already true, so the missing `!Eof()` conjunct lets the loop body call `GetC()` from an exhausted decoder. The authoritative `-fix` image reaches the same guard point on the original witness but suppresses the body until `!Eof()` holds; the adjacent `".. "` perturbation then shows the protected `GetC()` event executing genuinely with `Eof()==0`.

nodes.state: At the loop body `c_next = GetC();`, the vulnerable original has `Eof()==1`, so `ReadClause()` issues the offending decoder read on an exhausted decoder object.
At the UTF-8 sink, `decoder->current == decoder->end`, so `uint8_t c = *decoder->current++;` dereferences the one-past-end cursor recorded by ASan.

edges.relation: The same decoder object inspected by the missing `!Eof()` guard is the decoder object immediately consumed by the following `GetC()` call.
The `GetC()` call at line 798 forwards that same decoder object into `text_decoder_getc()`, which then reaches `string_decoder_getc_utf_8(decoder)` and dereferences its end cursor.
